delta_update: Το BBC στις 23 Νοεμβρίου επανέρχεται στη διαμάχη Μαρόκου–Σενεγάλης για το AFCON 2025: επιτροπή εφέσεων της CAF κατακύρωσε τον Μάρτιο αποτέλεσμα 3–0 στο Μαρόκο, κρίνοντας ότι η Σενεγάλη παραιτήθηκε.

headline: AFCON: εκκρεμεί η τελική δικαστική αποτίμηση της διαμάχης

image.alt: A triptych showing, from left to right, Pape Gueye celebrating his goal for Senegal during the 2025 Afcon final, a black gavel resting its block, and Morocco forward Brahim diaz looking disconsolate. Gueye, visible from waist up wearing a green jersey, is running with his mouth wide open as he screams in joy while his right hand is spread in front of his chest as if he it about to beat it. The head of the gavel, which stands out boldly against a white background, features a copper band around its middle. Diaz, also visible from waist up, is wearing a white Morocco away jersey with red and green trim
